personal_agent_projects.name: CowAgent
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Chinese personal Agent harness with channels, planning, memory, tools, skills, scheduler, MCP, and browser support

personal_agent_projects.name: OpenManus
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Minimal ReAct and tool-calling loop with browser, file editor, AskHuman, and terminate tools
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Agent Trace, AgentRun lifecycle, AgentPlan snapshot, planning mode, and safe tool-observation UI
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: Browser and GUI automation remain mostly verification-only in Warframe Agent, not an end-user Agent capability

personal_agent_projects.name: LangManus
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Coordinator, planner, supervisor, researcher, coder, browser, and reporter multi-agent workflow
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Next architecture decision for whether Warframe Agent needs explicit roles beyond single Agent plus tool routing
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: No productized coordinator/planner/supervisor/reporter split exists yet inside Warframe Agent

personal_agent_projects.name: OpenHuman
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Local-first long-term memory, Memory Tree, Obsidian-style Markdown vault, channels, model routing, and voice
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Personal profile, safe conversation log vault, memory recall trace, and long-term preference summaries
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: Inspectable Markdown/Obsidian-style knowledge vault and personal data connector ingestion are not yet implemented

personal_agent_projects.name: EchoBot
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Decision, Roleplay, and Agent split for persona response, voice/Live2D UX, skills, async tasks, and long-term memory
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Chat mode layering, natural-language confirmations, and separation of immediate user-facing replies from safe background actions
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: Persona, voice, Live2D, and fast companion reply versus slow background task orchestration are not yet migrated

personal_agent_projects.name: Open-AutoGLM
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Phone and GUI Agent loop with visual-language perception, ADB/HDC actions, sensitive-action confirmation, and human takeover
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Safety-confirmed action design and future browser or GUI automation boundary planning
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: No phone, desktop GUI, or VLM action loop is implemented; current Playwright use is test verification

personal_agent_projects.name: OpenClaw
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Always-on personal assistant gateway with channels, extensions, skills, memory, voice, canvas, and plugins
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Runtime control panel, safety policy visibility, future channel/extension boundary, and installable skill conventions
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: Gateway, extensions, channel routing, voice, canvas, and plugin ecosystem are not yet Warframe Agent product layers

personal_agent_projects.name: Suna / Kortix
personal_agent_projects.primary_learning_focus: Full-stack generalist Agent runtime with sandbox computer, persistent workspace, skills, triggers, and 24/7 product surface
personal_agent_projects.warframe_mapping: Runtime status, scheduler visibility, background task boundaries, and future long-running operations model
personal_agent_projects.remaining_gap: Persistent sandbox computer, triggers, service recovery, and full deployment operations are not yet implemented
